author: Sunshine Sentinel
title: USF women's lacrosse earns major conference awards and six all-conference selections - Sunshine Sentinel
text:
The University of South Florida women’s lacrosse team announced on April 29 that it received six American Conference All-Conference selections, along with individual honors for Attacker, Midfielder, and Coaching Staff of the Year.
These recognitions highlight the team’s strong performance in its second season. Sofia Chepenik was named American Conference Attack Player of the Year and earned a unanimous First Team selection. Kaitlyn Tartaglione was honored as American Conference Midfielder of the Year, also earning a unanimous First Team spot. Head Coach Mindy McCord and her staff were recognized as the American Conference Coaching Staff of the Year after leading USF to an undefeated record in conference play.
Chepenik finished her season with 45 goals and 15 assists, surpassing career milestones including over 150 points and more than 100 goals. Tartaglione concluded her collegiate career with a two-way performance that included 22 goals, three assists, and contributions across ground balls, draw controls, and caused turnovers.
Second Team honors went to Elise Grissett (Attack), Maggie Newton (Attack), Kali Cleary (Midfield), and Maddie Morris (Defense). Grissett scored 35 goals this season while Newton led USF with a career-high 33 assists. Cleary led in draw controls for the team during her sophomore year, while Morris anchored the defense with new personal bests in caused turnovers and ground balls.
The Bulls became only the second program to win a conference championship within their first two seasons of play. They led several statistical categories in their league—including shots taken, scoring offense, scoring margin, points per game, draw control percentage—and finished ranked No.14 nationally in RPI at season’s end.
USF’s women’s lacrosse program continues to build on its historic inaugural year under McCord’s leadership. The team opened its first-ever season on Feb.7 last year before drawing over ten thousand fans throughout that campaign.
